نِطَعٌ and ↓ نِطْعٌ and نَطَعٌ and نَطْعٌ A certain thing (Munjid of Kr, Mgh, Msb, K) that is spread [upon the ground to serve as a table for food, and for play at chess or the like, and to receive the head of a person when it is cut off], (Munjid, K,) made of leather; (Munjid, Mgh, Msb, K;) a piece of leather that is spread upon the ground for any of the purposes above mentioned. ―
-b2- The anterior part of the palate; see غار.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
